all_archive_question_coverage.ideal_comparison: exact text against current dataset ideal, only unambiguous exact-question matches; not a judgment of answer quality

evidence_manifest.source_labels_relative_to: original 8-19-run directory (not a claimed run date)

method.attempted_records: stored rows, not provider request/retry counts
method.failure_caveat: Failure/fallback counts describe archive flags, not confirmed provider failures. Current legacy scorer accepts judge results only when accuracy_score > 0 (src/scorer.py:dual_llm_judge_score). The two both-failed records contain substantive explanations justifying zero. Excluding their zeros is a flag-filtered sensitivity analysis, not an established correction; compare recorded_numeric_mean. Lost judge scores cannot be reconstructed reliably.
method.pairing: within run/model, exact-question intersection with valid scores in both modes; all duplicate question/mode keys excluded
method.provenance: July 26 2025 authorship is user recollection, not established by these exports; directory 8-19-run is a source label, not a date claim
method.question_join: SHA256(exact UTF-8 question), additionally checked for exact text equality
method.scope: three separate export groups, no cross-run pooled leaderboard or temporal/causal interpretation
method.score: archived accuracy_score, finite numeric [0,1], excluding explicit both-judge failures and generation failures; genuine zero retained
method.single_fallback: included when otherwise valid, also reported separately; not dual agreement
method.uncertainty: question-level percentile bootstrap, fixed seed and sorted question hashes; fixed-panel descriptive uncertainty, not model/judge run-to-run variance
unknown: actual judge model identifiers and revisions
historical request parameters and provider revisions
independence of collection processes across export groups
method.unrun: no stored records: mean null, not zero
